playerControl.title: Player control
playerControl.lede: A reality-check reminder, a cool-off pause, or self-exclusion. You choose when to stop. Nothing here rewards a longer session.
playerControl.age: You must be 18 or older to create an account or play.
playerControl.chase: Never chase losses. Never play with money you need for anything else.
playerControl.empty: No control options are available right now.
playerControl.guestNote: You can read these options. Sign in to save a reminder or start a pause.
playerControl.realityBody: A reminder on this device after the time you choose. It is not a limit enforced by the platform.
playerControl.deviceTime: Device time. Not an enforced limit.
playerControl.coolBody: A temporary pause. It blocks login, and it is not as final as self-exclusion.
playerControl.coolFactLogin: You cannot sign in for the period you choose.
playerControl.coolFactNoCancel: You cannot cancel the pause early.
playerControl.reasonOptional: Optional. Shown only if you choose one.
playerControl.coolConfirmBody: You will be signed out. Login stays blocked for this period, and you cannot end the pause early.
playerControl.excludeBody: This is more serious than a cool-off. Read what happens before you confirm. There is no early reactivation.
playerControl.excludeConsequenceLogin: Login stays blocked until the period ends.
playerControl.excludeConsequenceNoCancel: You cannot reactivate the account early.
playerControl.excludeConfirmBody: This closes your session now. You will not be able to sign in until the period ends, and it cannot be undone early.
playerControl.customDate: A custom end date cannot be sent.
playerControl.noPeriods: No periods are available right now.
playerControl.noIntervals: No reminder intervals are available right now.
playerControl.reminderBody: You have been signed in for {time}. This reminder is on your device. It is not a limit enforced by the platform.
playerControl.receiptDisclaimer: Stored only in this browser until you sign in again. This note is not account protection.

pages.sportsLede: Sports sits next to Casino and Live Casino on purpose. Odds, fixtures, and bet slips are not connected yet, so this room stays honest instead of pretending to be a book.
pages.promoLede: These previews are not connected to a bonus engine, and nothing here changes your balance.
pages.promoWelcomeBody: A first-session highlight for new players. Creating an account does not credit a bonus by itself.
pages.promoWeekendBody: Tables we want in front of you when the live floor is busy. No wagering rules are attached yet.
pages.promoJournalBody: When a new room or category lands, the note shows up in the journal before it becomes a campaign.
pages.journalLede: Short product notes. This is editorial content, not a feed from the game catalog.
pages.journalLobbyBody: Casino, Live Casino, and Sports stay in one switch so you can change rooms without hunting through a side menu. Games then sit in a grid you can scan, with a short popular row only when there is enough to feature.
pages.journalLiveBody: Live tables are their own destination: same account, different pace. Open Live Casino when you want a dealer rather than a slot.
pages.privacyLede: A product draft of what the app handles. This is not the final privacy notice.
pages.privacy1: Registration and login details stay on the server. The browser keeps an httpOnly session cookie, not the platform token.
pages.privacy2: The lobby loads the game catalog through our own API. Game thumbnails may load from a provider address when the catalog includes one.
pages.privacy3: We do not put passwords, phone numbers, or session secrets in the public pages.
pages.termsLede: A product draft so the footer has a real destination. This is not the final legal agreement.
pages.terms1: AlphaBet provides casino, live casino, and sportsbook play through the platform account.
pages.terms2: You are responsible for the accuracy of the details you register with. One person, one account.
pages.terms3: Promotions are previews. They do not credit a bonus wallet.
pages.responsibleLede: Set a reality-check reminder, pause the account, or self-exclude.
pages.responsible1: You must be 18 or older to create an account or play.
pages.responsible2: Reality check, cool-off, and self-exclusion are in Player control. A cool-off or self-exclusion signs you out, blocks login for the period you choose, and cannot be cancelled early.
pages.responsible3: Never chase losses. Never play with money you need for anything else.
pages.supportLede: Ask in Support chat. A person is offered from the same chat when a contact method is configured.
pages.support1: If registration finishes but sign-in does not, use Login with the same email. Your account can exist before the session cookie is set.
pages.support2: Game launch problems stay on the table you opened: retry from the game view, or return to the lobby and pick the game again.
pages.support3: Talk to a person stays available even if the assistant cannot answer. Contact details are shown only when they are configured.
